learning_outcomes.description: Compare cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, Serverless) and architect high-availability cloud deployments.
Containerize multi-tier applications and orchestrate microservices with Docker Compose and Kubernetes.
Implement automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with automated linting, testing, and secret scanning.

weeks.topic: Cloud Architecture Fundamentals, Virtualization, and Hyperscaler Concepts.
Cloud Storage and Compute Services (Virtual Machines, Object Storage, Block Storage).
Containerization Foundations, Dockerfile Optimization, and Multi-stage Builds.
Microservices Architecture and Multi-container Systems with Docker Compose.
Container Orchestration with Kubernetes: Pods, Services, Deployments, and Ingress.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and Declarative Provisioning.
CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions, Automated Testing, and Artifact Packaging.
Cloud Observability: Structured Logging, Distributed Tracing, and Prometheus/Grafana Metrics.
Final Project Defense and Cloud Native Production Audit.
